notes_for_editor: No build year exists in the sources; the 'likely after 1940' statement is the register's own inference. The FFLA standing list is undated. No staffing, fire, access or photo-credit source beyond the register was found. The name Quarry is unexplained. It is not confirmed that this tower is one of the 72 DNR towers named in the 2015 article, though the register says the DNR administers it. Two websearch calls were used on this tower. No new photos.
